purpose: Route inventory: the single hand-maintained source of the public HTTP surface. scripts/generate_openapi.py joins it with brain.schema.json, registry.json and authorization-matrix.json into contracts/v1/openapi.json. $ref values are names of brain.schema.json $defs.

info.title: Keyrus Brain baseline transport
info.description: Current target transport. Better Auth (/api/auth/*) and the SPA fallback are not described here. Authentication: routes with an empty security list are public; every other route needs the stated credential. This document itself needs a signed-in credential. Command and query bodies are discriminated unions: see x-brain-commands and x-brain-queries.

humanSession.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token
humanSession.description: Better Auth cookie name/prefix is set by the pinned production configuration; HTTPS may use its secure-prefixed cookie name. Ingress reads the vendor session API, not a manually parsed cookie.

localSetup.name: Authorization
localSetup.description: Setup <one-use credential from the private Governor setup.token file>; never a public default.

chatSignature.name: X-Brain-Signature
chatSignature.description: Brain or Slack request signature inside a 5 minute window; never a session.

metricsToken.description: BRAIN_METRICS_TOKEN_FILE token; the route does not exist when it is unset.

200.description: Current user's sessions without credential tokens

204.description: No eligible work before poll timeout

200.description: Authorized execution-stream frames: {streamSeq, eventId, type, severity, emitter, source, aggregateId, workspaceId?, at, correlation?, summary} on the default message channel; `reset` is the only named control frame

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: execution_stream stream_seq cursor; the sole replay position

parameters.name: live
parameters.description: 1 subscribes to the live stream; any other value replays one bounded page

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: workspace id filter, resolved in SQL before any page limit

parameters.name: maxLag
parameters.description: live streams falling further behind than this receive a reset frame (default 5000)

200.description: Bounded sanitized NDJSON log segment as an attachment: one record per line with {streamSeq, eventId, emitter, eventType, severity, at, correlation?, summary}; payloads travel only as references. Authorization is identical to stream reads
